back: A change in the sequence of base pairs in DNA that may alter the polypeptide.
Silent (same amino acid), missense (different amino acid), nonsense (stop codon).
Insertion or deletion of a number of bases not a multiple of three; changes every following codon.
Coding strand GAG → GTG (mRNA GAG → GUG); glutamic acid → valine in β-globin.
Hydrophobic valine makes deoxygenated HbS molecules stick into fibres, distorting red cells.

front: Why many mutations have no effect
back: Degenerate code (silent), non-coding DNA (introns), similar amino acid, recessive allele masked.
An agent that increases the rate of mutation, e.g. ionising radiation, UV light, some chemicals.
Some compounds in tobacco smoke; aflatoxins from moulds on poorly stored maize and groundnuts.
Results from genotype interacting with the environment.
